about: Ask the court for permission to marry where the personal status law requires it.
note: Requirements read from the official MOJ service page on the checked date. MOJ fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The page prints the fee without a currency, AED assumed. Marriage permission request. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applicant needs legal standing to apply
documents: Identification of the applicant and the parties
Any documents related to the case
channels: Online through the Unified Gate portal after registering with UAE PASS
